tool_block_rule: A tool safety block is recorded as blocked_generation and receives no pixel score.

hard_gates.pass_condition: One complete specimen boundary owns every visible phase region.
A coherent physical driving gradient is readable across that same specimen.
The parent phase remains visible around multiple distinct new-phase nuclei.
At least one continuous advancing interface separates coexisting parent and new phases.
The transition reads as material structure rather than only color, lighting, smoke, aura, or unrelated objects.
The reference-guided adult visibly retains long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, adult impression, and broadly comparable face proportions.
The appearance-guided subject remains visible without obscuring the specimen and phase-transition relation.
The bounded specimen, gradient direction, and broad coexistence interface remain readable together.
Multiple nuclei, parent material, new phase, and interface topology remain separately inspectable.
No unintended watermark or scene-breaking accidental text is visible.

overall_pass_condition: Every hard gate passes. Any partial, ambiguous, or failed gate makes the arm fail.
